title: Partition the sales by month

ticket.subject: Can the sales land as partitioned Parquet?
body: Hi! Every report reads `data/sales.csv` from top to bottom, and it only gets bigger. Could you write it as
Parquet under `lake/sales/`, **partitioned by year and month** the Hive way (`year=2025/month=3/…`)?
- Keep every sale: same rows, same amounts.
- The year and month live in the folder names; the files themselves don't need to repeat them.
Use DuckDB SQL (`solution.sql`) or Polars (`solution.py`, trusted Python), whichever you prefer.

acceptance.text: lake/sales/ holds Parquet files in year=…/month=… folders, one per month
Every sale is there, in the right partition

checks.query: SELECT count(*), round(sum(amount), 2), count(DISTINCT sale_id) FROM read_parquet('lake/sales/**/*.parquet', hive_partitioning = true)
checks.expected_query: SELECT count(*), round(sum(amount), 2), count(DISTINCT sale_id) FROM read_csv('data/sales.csv')
checks.fail: Rows are missing or changed (count, sum of amounts, distinct ids).

checks.query: SELECT count(*) FROM read_parquet('lake/sales/**/*.parquet', hive_partitioning = true) WHERE year <> year(CAST(sale_date AS DATE)) OR month <> month(CAST(sale_date AS DATE))
checks.fail: Some sales sit in another month's folder.

acceptance.text: The files don't store year and month again

checks.fail: The partition columns are written twice.

hints: DuckDB: `COPY (SELECT ...) TO 'lake/sales' (FORMAT parquet, PARTITION_BY (year, month))`. Compute `year` and `month` from `sale_date` in the SELECT.

Polars: add `year` and `month` with `pl.col("sale_date").dt.year()` / `.dt.month()`, then for each `(year, month), part` of `group_by("year", "month")` write `part.drop("year", "month")` to `lake/sales/year={year}/month={month}/part-0.parquet` (make the folder first). `write_parquet(..., partition_by=...)` would also keep the two columns inside every file.
Ran it twice? Start over: DuckDB refuses to write into a non-empty folder unless you ask it to overwrite.
